Hi Kaggle team,
I accidentally replaced one of the agents that I intended to keep for the final evaluation, and I have already exhausted today’s 5-submission allowance.
My current latest two active submissions are approximately:

  • 1959.9 — intended final submission
  • 837.0 — accidentally retained as one of the latest two submissions The immediately preceding submission, rated approximately 1996.8, is the agent that I actually intended to keep for the final evaluation together with the 1959.9 submission. Unfortunately, my daily submission allowance will reset only after the competition submission deadline, so I cannot simply resubmit the 1996.8 agent before submissions close. Is there any supported way to either:
  • reactivate the previous 1996.8 submission, or
  • withdraw/deactivate the accidental 837.0 submission so that the previous submission becomes active again? I am not requesting an additional submission or an increase in the submission quota. I am only asking whether it is possible to correct which already-submitted agents remain active for the final evaluation. The deadline is only a few hours away, so I would greatly appreciate any guidance if this can be addressed before submissions close. Thank you very much.
